scripts.build: npm run build:lib && tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:server
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && npm run build:font-previews && node scripts/source-archive.mjs
scripts.predev: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && npm run build:lib && npm run build:font-previews && node scripts/source-archive.mjs
scripts.build:lib: npm run build --workspace=@thierryc/openplotfont && npm run build --workspace=@thierryc/plotter-core
scripts.build:server: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node scripts/build-server.mjs
scripts.prebuild:browser: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && npm run build:font-previews && node scripts/source-archive.mjs
scripts.build:browser: npm run build:lib && tsc -b && vite build --mode browser --outDir dist-browser && node scripts/package-browser.mjs
scripts.prebuild:site: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && npm run build:font-previews && node scripts/source-archive.mjs
scripts.build:site: npm run build:lib && tsc -b && vite build --mode site --outDir ../dist-site --emptyOutDir && node scripts/package-site.mjs
scripts.test:site-build: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && PLOT_SITE_BUILD_DIR=dist-site vitest run server/site-build.test.ts
